positions.commentary: The speaker mentions Netflix as a competing activity for learners' time when discussing why people should use an online learning platform.

thesis: The provided claims are insufficient to form a thesis, as they only mention Netflix as a competing activity for learners' time without offering an investment argument or view.

claims.claim: The speaker mentions Netflix as a competing activity for learners' time when discussing why people should use an online learning platform.
claims.quote: Because if you have an online learning platform, the learners are ultimately there, they're saying, like, am I going to log into this platform now, or am I going to log into Netflix? Or am I going to play soccer with my kids? Or I'm going to do YouTube.

numbers.quote: About 80% of jobs in the U.S. and similar in other countries that pay well, say they require a college degree.

numbers.what: percentage of Americans earning a college degree
numbers.quote: But in our country, actually, only about a third of Americans earn a college degree.

numbers.what: percentage of Americans who don't know their schedule for the following week
numbers.quote: About a quarter of Americans don't even know their schedule for the following week.
